12A.
Council initiated item from Council Member Luke Shaffer regarding Long-Term Growth Planning: Conceptual Land Use and Infrastructure Renderings for Future Population Scenarios and functional use (adjacent residents i.e. south Carlsbad, district 4) in the City of Encinitas (75,000 / 95,000 Residents); and Proactive Planning for Encinitas: Conceptual Land Use & Infrastructure Scenarios to Protect Community Character and Local Control Amid State Housing Pressures: Visualizing Encinitas at Potential Future Population Thresholds (75,000 / 95,000).
Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment.
1) Direct staff to utilize the recently acquired visualization and planning software to create 2-3 conceptual renderings for each of the following population thresholds: 75,000 residents and 95,000 residents. These renderings should include land use, transportation corridors, public facilities, and infrastructure considerations. Staff may coordinate with planning and public works departments to align the renderings with realistic development capacity and fiscal constraints. 2) Direct staff to use recently acquired visualization and planning software to prepare 2-3 conceptual renderings for each of the following hypothetical thresholds: 75,000 residents and 95,000 residents. These renderings should reflect local priorities, capacity limits, and fiscal realities, not state-driven quotas. These renderings should include land use, transportation corridors, public facilities, and infrastructure considerations. Staff may coordinate with planning and public works departments to align the renderings with realistic development capacity and fiscal constraints. They will NOT serve as growth targets, but as a defensive planning tool to help the City of Encinitas resist overdevelopment and protect community values.
2025-08-20 Item 12A Council Initiated Item Shaffer - Total City Renderings
2025-08-20 Item 12A Council Initiated Item Shaffer - Total City Renderings - Public Comment

Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a “project” under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in direct or indirect physical change in the environment.

2025-08-20 Item 12C Council Initiated Item Lyndes - Pacific View Arts Center
2025-08-20 Item 12C Council Initiated Item Lyndes - Pacific View Arts Center - Public Comment
12D.
Council initiated item by Councilmembers Marco San Antonio and Jim O'Hara to establish a new municipal code section under Chapter 9.01 prohibiting the use of a vehicle as living quarters during restricted hours.
Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in direct or indirect physical change in the environment.
Direct city staff and legal counsel to draft an ordinance to add a new municipal code section entitled Use of Vehicle as Living Quarters, prohibiting the use of vehicles as living quarters during certain hours and to establish vehicle-based enforcement procedures. Draft to be presented for council review and consideration at a future meeting and incorporating the attached provisions "Proposed Ordinance/Municipal Code Language."

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
